pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SUGISAWA HOSPITAL

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HOW IS IGUCHI DOING?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE DOCTORS SAY HE'S FINE, BUT ... HE'S STILL UNCON- sCIOUS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S ALL MY FAULT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S BECAUSE I TOLD HIM TO COME TO SCHOOL THAT NIGHT...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: YOU PROBABLY WON'T BELIEVE ME.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: ...BUT WE WERE ATTACKED BY A STRANGE MONSTER.. ...AND I WAS CAPTURED TOO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I BELIEVE YOU.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THOSE WEREN'T MONSTERS. THEY WERE CURSES.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THAT FINGERIS SOMETHING CALLED A SPECIAL- GRADE CURSED OBJECT. IT WAS ABLE TO GATHER CURSES AND MAKE ITSELF STRONGER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ITA- DORI?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SO IT'S NOT YOUR FAULT. I'M THE ONE WHO PICKED IT UP IN THE FIRST PLACE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'M SORRY, BUT DON'T WORRY.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THERE'S SOMEONE COMING TOMORROW WHO CAN HELP IGUCHI.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'M SORRY SASAKI.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THERE'S SOMEWHERE I NEED TO GO.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'LL SEE YA LATER.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WHO PASSED AWAY?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: MY GRANDPA. BUT I GUESS HE'S MORE LIKE A DAD.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I SEE. SORRY TO BOTHER YOU AT A TIME LIKE THIS.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: SO, HAVE YOU MADE A DECISION?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ARE THERE A LOT OF CASUALTIES WITH CURSES LIKE THIS?
